rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: A PT portal item dated 8 January 2003 says that the PT's national president, deputy José Genoíno, would try that day to contact the presidents of the PMDB, PSDB and PFL about the elections for the presidencies of the Chamber and the Senate; he gave the information after a morning meeting at the Planalto with the Chief of Staff, José Dirceu.
